sceneLabel: Silhouette of a stepped government building beside a river, with alarm lights
order: If that file is published in full, 007 ceases to exist. Not as a man: as an agent. Recover every copy. And leave no trace.

tracker.name: Tracker radio
tracker.perk: One extra hint in the interrogation.

qLine: Please, try to bring it back. Even if it's just one piece.
departureLabel: The camera leaves through the MI6 window and flies over London
